summary: Ran required backend suites (iter316+iter317) and browser validation for R&D lifecycle, routing/responsiveness, and sales quickview variant selection. R&D lifecycle flow is working end-to-end after proper waits; major blockers remain in sales quickview variant resolution on both mobile and desktop.

ui_bugs.issue: Variant combo state is inconsistent: invalid combo still reports add button not disabled in automation state checks; recovery to valid combo still keeps SKU/price/stock as dash and add remains blocked, preventing checkout flow.
Invalid combo does not fully lock actions (add/print/roll toggles not disabled consistently), and combo recovery can end in cleared state (subtotal/stock dash) with add disabled.
At 390 viewport, create modal opens but family selector starts disabled and requires loading wait before interaction.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete browser checkout because variant resolution never reached selectable valid SKU state in quickview; add-to-cart blocked in UI.
Console shows intermittent 404 for product media content URL on some products.

action_items: Fix quickview variant matching/state synchronization (mobile + desktop) so invalid combo consistently disables add/print/roll and valid recovery restores SKU/price/stock with enabled add.
Re-run stock-backed sales browser E2E after quickview fix: verify persisted sales_order.items[].product_id and reservation relation, then cancel test SO.
Investigate intermittent product media content 404 in catalog/quickview rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: Variant selection likely mixes display attrs vs option codes during matching (e.g., value labels like 'Small/110 cm' vs codes 'S/W110'), causing false 'kombinasi tidak tersedia' and stale disabled state.
Desktop quickview guardrails are not uniformly enforced: controls stay enabled while selected variant resolves to null/dash state.
Do not regress R&D policy guards: all-entity create disabled and deep-link create bypass blocked are currently correct.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter4_family_b485f1ac (template ptpl_c2e85ba6c7b5), seeded 2 variants, stock, approved media, and /app/test_reports/iter4_seed.json for deterministic browser flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: R&D flow validated: MD create->submit and manager approve/release passed; spec deep-link to catalog and catalog R&D tab/back passed; all-entity create/deep-link bypass checks passed; routing alias product-templates<->md-products and viewport 390/768/desktop overflow checks passed. Continue from quickview blocker before reattempting full mobile checkout assertion.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open seeded family TEST_iter4_family_b485f1ac in mobile/desktop quickview, pick axis combination then switch to another axis value. Observed states become contradictory (button/control disabled flags not aligned with dash SKU/price/stock state). Likely root cause is inconsistent normalization/matching between variant_attrs and variant_options (code-vs-label mismatch) plus stale derived state after axis changes. Mitigation: centralize variant key normalization across VariantAxisPicker + quickviews, assert selected variant existence before enabling action controls, and recompute availability atomically on every axis change.
